<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_grants"}
#docs
`category: promotional` (the default) books the credit at once. `category: paid` also needs `invoices:manage`: it creates an invoice for `price_minor` (the net price, which is the cost basis) taxed by `tax_treatment`, and a `pending` grant that becomes `active` when the invoice is paid. With `mark_paid` the invoice is recorded as paid in the same request, so the response shows `active`. Paid credit never exists without an invoice. Needs `credits:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | `string` | no | Default `promotional`. One of `promotional`, `paid`. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | A credit unit's id. Null or absent = money. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Money grants only. Default: the customer's currency. |
| `amount` | `integer` | **yes** | In the unit's smallest step (money: minor units). |
| `priority` | `integer` | no | 0 to 100. Default 50. |
| `effective_at` | `string` | no | Promotional only. Default now. Unix seconds, or an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. |
| `expires_at` | `string` | no | Default: no expiry. Unix seconds, or an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. |
| `applicability` | `object` | no | Default: every usage line (`metered`). |
| `applicability.kind` | `string` | **yes** | The applicability's kind. One of `metered`, `prices`, `meters`. |
| `applicability.prices` | `array of string` | no | The applicability's prices. |
| `applicability.meters` | `array of string` | no | The applicability's meters. |
| `on_exhausted` | `string` | no | What happens when the credit is used up, for a business with blocking on. Null = not set here. One of `block`, `bill`. |
| `metadata` | `object` | no | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit grant. |
| `price_minor` | `integer` | no | Paid only: the net price, without tax. It is the cost basis. |
| `tax_treatment` | `string` | no | Paid only, required. `taxed_at_use` is for money credit only. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `mark_paid` | `object` | no | Paid only: record the invoice as paid now, so the credit is active at once. |
| `mark_paid.method` | `string` | **yes** | cash \| check \| bank_transfer \| other |
| `mark_paid.reference` | `string` | no | Your reference for the payment. |
| `mark_paid.paid_at` | `string` | no | Default now. Unix seconds, or an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_grant`. One of `credit_grant`. |
| `id` | `string` | cgr_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `unit` | `string` | The credit unit's id. Null = money. |
| `amount` | `integer` | Units at grant, in the unit's smallest step (money: minor units). |
| `amount_decimal` | `string` | `amount` in whole units, as a decimal string. |
| `face_minor` | `integer` | The money value at grant. Fixed for life. |
| `cost_basis_minor` | `integer` | Paid: the net money received for it. Promotional: 0. |
| `category` | `string` | The credit grant's category. One of `paid`, `promotional`. |
| `priority` | `integer` | 0 to 100. Lower draws first. |
| `effective_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The effective time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant expires (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `applicability` | `object` | Which invoice lines the grant may pay: `{"kind":"metered"}` (every usage line, the default), `{"kind":"prices","prices":["…"]}`, or `{"kind":"meters","meters":["…"]}` (meter keys: the usage lines of every price that bills the meter when the grant draws). A `metered` grant takes the business's `credit_config.credit_scope` when one is set. |
| `source` | `string` | Where the credit grant comes from. One of `purchase`, `plan_cycle`, `manual`, `restore`, `auto_top_up`. |
| `tax_treatment` | `string` | The credit grant's tax treatment. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `on_exhausted` | `string` | What happens when the credit is used up, for a business with blocking on. Null = not set here. One of `block`, `bill`. |
| `status` | `string` | The credit grant's status. One of `pending`, `active`, `expired`, `voided`. |
| `invoice` | `string` | The invoice that sold it (paid grants). |
| `restored_from` | `string` | The expired grant this one restores. |
| `auto_top_up_run` | `string` | atur_…: the automatic top-up run that sold it. |
| `remaining` | `object` | What is left: the sum of the grant's movements. |
| `metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit grant. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The credit grant. |
| `400` | The body is not correct, or a rule refuses the grant. |
| `403` | A paid grant needs `invoices:manage` too. |
| `404` | No such customer or credit unit. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_grants" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "currency": "USD",
    "amount": 2900
  }'
```
